title: Evangel Spear
paragraphs: As I was struggling to decide how to fight, Father spoke.
“Is it called System Experience? It seems like you don’t understand something important, so as a Hero… no, as the victor of this battle, I’ll give you the answer.”
Father, confident in his victory, took a step forward.

“Even if you’ve been absorbing experience from all over the world, whether it’s because you can’t fully convert it into power, or because we and the Four Holy Weapons are simply stronger—I can’t say for sure. But the biggest mistake you made was that, despite launching such a large-scale attack… you couldn’t break through my defense!”
I could see skill markers floating around Father as he chanted.
“Defense Link X! Liberation Aura X! Now everyone can charge through this rain of attacks! Crush the enemy with everything you’ve got!”
“Got it, here I gooo!”

Following Father’s command, Rival leapt out of the barrier, claws appearing on both his arms, and instantly took down the demons that had been providing cover fire. Of course, he was definitely taking hits, but there wasn’t a single scratch on him.
“I’m going too!”
Sakura-chan, not to be outdone, dashed out of the barrier alongside Rival. She rushed toward System Experience, twirling as she swung the swords in each hand.
“I guess I’ll join in as well.”
Big sister’s sister struck her spear with lightning and threw it toward System Experience.
“Lightning Harpoon… no, wait, Spear!”
“I’m coming too!”
Ren followed suit, charging out while raising his sword.
“Let’s do this!”
Is that the skill he gained from the sword he found in the treasure vault?
“Claiomh Solais X!”
When Ren swung his sword, a blade of light, similar to Brionac’s, shot out.
Did he use it the wrong way? Eventually, he adjusted and thrust it forward, mimicking the same stance I use.
“Light Sword—Claiomh Solais!”
Kuro-chan shouted in excitement. She was standing by Ren’s side, as if supporting him. Ren didn’t seem to mind it at all.
“I’m going too. Come on, Raphtalia-chan!”
“Y-Yeah!”
“Ah, wait for me, Rifana!”
Big sister, her friend, and Kou all rushed out together.
Hmm? It looked like Kou, who was carrying them, split apart and began taking down all the surrounding enemies.
A multi-shadow clone technique! It seemed like each one of them had a solid presence. Yet, Kou, big sister, and her friend were also resting beside Father, catching their breath.

What’s this? Even though they’ve split, they’re taking a break? It’s almost like the fatigue of all the clones was being transferred to them. And the original versions of big sister and her group were using themselves as stepping stones to launch attacks on System Experience.
A crack appeared in the mechanical parts of System Experience, and sparks of energy began leaking out.
“We’re going too!”
“Of course, I’m going as well!”

If we don’t go now, we won’t be able to defeat the enemy. I looked at Father. Even though smoke was rising from his entire body as he bore the burden of everyone’s damage, he smiled as if to reassure us that he was fine. The physician stood by Father’s side, supporting him with a worried expression.
“I’m fine! More importantly, hurry! Defeat the enemy!”
“Understood!”
I jumped onto Yuki-chan’s back as she transformed into her filolial form. Then, I leapt toward System Experience.
“Everyone, get back! I’m going to use my trump card!”

I had a special skill I was saving for the moment I would ride on Filo-tan’s back. A skill that draws out the full potential of the Filolial-samas while combining it with my own power. The ultimate skill that had been resting in my hands. I had vowed to unleash this skill only with Filo-tan, but if it’s Father’s wish, I have no choice. This skill, which I hadn’t even used against the Four Guardian Beasts… I’ll show it now.
“F Evangel Spear!”

I believe the F stands for Filolial-sama. Yes, this skill can only be activated when I’m riding on a filolial. The power I received from all the Filolial-samas I’ve been with flows through my body into Yuki-chan. And that same power raises my own abilities as well. Everything seemed to move in slow motion.
Ah… I really wanted to release this miracle of a skill together with Filo-tan.
“Yuki-chan, are you okay?”
“I’m fine!”
“Then, here we go!”
“Yes!”

Faster than Ren and Itsuki, who were using all twelve enhancements, and even faster than Father, Yuki-chan and I dashed under System Experience and leapt high. Then, as I spun my spear, Yuki-chan, who had carried me, scattered like light and reappeared behind me in her angelic form.
“What… what should I do, Motoyasu-sama?”
“Your instincts should tell you.”
“Yes… I understand.”
Right now, Yuki-chan’s body carried the thoughts of all the Filolial-samas I had encountered.
“Through Motoyasu-sama, I can hear the voices of all the Filolials!”
Yuki-chan leaned against my back and poured her power into the spear. From the spear, wings of light emerged, releasing energy.
“Energy charge complete! It’s ready to fire at any time, Motoyasu-sama!”
“Of course, here we go!”
I hurled the spear toward System Experience with great force.
“Filo-tan, I looooooove yoooooooouuuuuuuuuu!”
“No—impossible—Medi—”

System Experience was pierced by the skill that Yuki-chan and I had unleashed at high speed, creating a gaping hole. From that hole, the light of the wings spread out, consuming the machine and transforming it into radiant feathers. The skill I had unleashed soared high into the sky, piercing through the barrier that System Experience had erected and flying upward. The demons had already been completely obliterated by Ren and my rival’s attacks. Even the roof of the laboratory where System Experience was located had been blown away. All that remained was a ruined wasteland where feathers gently fell.
“We did it!”
I landed with Yuki-chan and gave Father a thumbs-up.
Filo-tan, did you see that? I’ve saved the world once again.
“Well… I guess that’s good. But…”
It must have been the aftermath of defeating System Experience, but a rumbling sound echoed from beneath us.
“Uh… this seems dangerous. Shouldn’t we be thinking about escaping?”
“You’re right. Gaelion, what about the barrier?”
“It’s completely gone.”
“Then let’s hurry and get out! Can we use a teleportation skill…? No, it’s still unusable!”
“After all that, this place must still be an activation site.”
“Alright then, Filolial-samas! Time to escape!”
“Aren’t we going to ride Gaelion-chan?”
Father, trying to arrange the escape, spoke to my rival, who had turned into his dragon form to carry everyone.
Hmph… what a foolish question.
“We don’t need the power of a dragon! Now, Filolial-samas, let’s go!”
“Yay!”
And so, we all took off running.
Is Father not coming with us?
“Uh… wait, he’s climbing up the wall!?”
“Naofumi, let’s go.”
“Hurry up and escape! Sakura, take Gaelion and go!”
“Y-yeah! I’m sorry, Sakura-chan!”
“Yaaah!”
My rival flapped his wings and grabbed Sakura-chan, who had gone back to pick up Father, and flew off. And so, we escaped from the laboratory.

Was there going to be a collapse? We had regrouped outside the city, but aside from the burst of light, nothing significant seemed to have happened. The eerie distortion in the sky was now completely gone.
“Come to think of it, it’s not hot even though the sun is out.”
“It’s actually cool.”
“Maybe the thing that was turning this place into a desert was removed?”
Just as Father said that, water gushed out from one corner of the desert. It started to rain.
“Whoa…”
“A blessed rain, isn’t it?”
“Is that what this is?”
“A complete victory.”

In one corner of the city, a fountain seemed to have sprung up, and a pillar of water was visible. When the rain eventually stopped, a land overflowing with light stretched before us, as if nothing had ever happened.
